# AMC Auth Card

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Region Template** for Universal Theme · direction: motion · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.1

A motion-rich authentication card for login, sign-up, forgot-password, OTP and reset pages: seven looks, seven full-screen scenes drawn behind the page, and opt-in field behaviour by item CSS class, while items, validations and processes stay native.

**Use it for:** The Static Content region that holds the page items and buttons of an authentication page: the app's Login page, Create account, Forgot password, OTP verification and Reset password.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_auth_card.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/region-templates/amc-auth-card.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

On any region, set **Appearance > Template** to **AMC Auth Card**. In APEXlang: `appearance { template: @amc-auth-card }`.

Region template for authentication pages: Login, Create account, Forgot password, OTP verification and Reset password. The region title becomes the card heading and the region icon a logo badge. Put native page items and buttons in the region: buttons in Create or Next are the full-width primary actions, Previous and Close are secondary, Help renders as a link row, and sub regions sit below the buttons (social sign-in, 'Forgot password? / Create account' links). LOOKS (pick one; none selected = Glass, a frosted card): Split (brand panel beside the form; a sub region with CSS class amc-auth-brand is moved into the panel as its headline, stacks on phones), Brutal, Clay, Minimal (borderless, big type), Neon (dark card with a glowing edge beam), Paper (editorial sheet). Focused fields get an animated underline and an accent label in every look. SCENES (pick one; none selected = Aurora): Meteors, Grid spotlight (follows the pointer, drifts when idle), Mesh and grain, Retro grid, Particles, No scene. The scene is a fixed decorative layer behind the page, pointer-events none; only the first Auth Card on a page draws one. Stage contains the scene inside the region for use in dialogs or normal pages. FIELD BEHAVIOUR is opt-in by Page Item > Advanced > CSS Classes: amc-auth-password (show/hide toggle button with aria-pressed, Caps Lock warning), amc-auth-strength (live strength meter Weak/Fair/Good/Strong; informative only), amc-auth-match (match state against the previous amc-auth-password item), amc-auth-otp (the one real text item is shown as N boxes; N from Custom Attribute data-amc-length or the item's Maximum Length, default 6; inputmode numeric, autocomplete one-time-code, paste fills all boxes, arrow keys, Backspace, Home and End move between boxes, the real item always holds the code so session state and validations are unchanged; use label template Optional - Above or Required - Above). On a button, CSS class amc-auth-resend disables it with a countdown; seconds from Custom Attribute data-amc-seconds, default 30. Template option Auto-submit OTP presses the first primary button once the code is complete. The primary button shows a spinner and aria-busy while the page submits; it never prevents the submit. When the page shows APEX errors the card shakes once and focuses the first invalid item. SECURITY stays server-side: the template is UI only. Write validations and processes for the password policy, neutral forgot-password wording, OTP expiry and attempt limits, rate limiting and token checks. TRANSLATION: English strings are data attributes on the region element in the template markup; edit them there: data-amc-show 'Show password', data-amc-hide 'Hide password', data-amc-caps 'Caps Lock is on', data-amc-strength 'Password strength: %0', data-amc-weak 'Weak', data-amc-fair 'Fair', data-amc-good 'Good', data-amc-strong 'Strong', data-amc-match 'Passwords match', data-amc-mismatch 'Passwords do not match', data-amc-digit 'Digit %0 of %1', data-amc-resend 'Resend in %0', data-amc-resend-ready 'You can request a new code now', data-amc-busy 'Please wait'. KEYBOARD AND MOTION: every control is a real button or input in DOM order; the OTP boxes keep left-to-right digit order in RTL. Under reduced motion scenes are static, beams stop as a static gradient, there is no shake and the spinner becomes a static ring. In forced-colors mode scenes and beams are hidden and the card becomes a plain system border.

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Look - Split brand panel | `amc-TAuthCard--split` | Brand panel with an illustration beside the form; a sub region with CSS class amc-auth-brand becomes its headline. Stacks above the form on narrow screens. Pick one look only. |
| Look - Neo-brutal | `amc-TAuthCard--brutal` | Ink border, hard offset shadow and heavy title. Pick one look only. |
| Look - Clay | `amc-TAuthCard--clay` | Pillowy radius with soft inner and outer shadows tinted by the primary color. Pick one look only. |
| Look - Minimal | `amc-TAuthCard--minimal` | No card surface; oversized heading and underlined code boxes straight on the scene. Pick one look only. |
| Look - Neon | `amc-TAuthCard--neon` | Dark card with a glowing border beam; native items inside follow the dark card through theme variables. Pick one look only. |
| Look - Paper | `amc-TAuthCard--paper` | Editorial paper sheet with grain, stacked pages and a double rule under the heading. Pick one look only. |
| Scene - Meteors | `amc-TAuthCard--sceneMeteors` | Meteor shower over faint stars with a glowing horizon. Pick one scene only; none selected shows Aurora. |
| Scene - Grid spotlight | `amc-TAuthCard--sceneGrid` | Grid lines lit by a spotlight that follows the pointer and drifts when idle. Pick one scene only. |
| Scene - Mesh and grain | `amc-TAuthCard--sceneMesh` | Slow mesh gradient from the primary hues with film grain. Pick one scene only. |
| Scene - Retro grid | `amc-TAuthCard--sceneRetro` | Perspective floor scrolling toward a striped sun. Pick one scene only. |
| Scene - Particles | `amc-TAuthCard--sceneParticles` | Glowing particles rising slowly, CSS only. Pick one scene only. |
| Scene - None | `amc-TAuthCard--sceneNone` | No scene; the page background of the theme shows. |
| Stage - scene inside the region | `amc-TAuthCard--stage` | Draws the scene inside the region instead of behind the whole page, for dialogs, normal pages or several cards on one page. |
| Auto-submit OTP | `amc-TAuthCard--otpAutoSubmit` | Presses the first primary button once every OTP box is filled. Validation still runs on the server. |
